case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quote and for setting out your cost drivers so openly. We value the reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

Looking at the full picture, our data shows a somewhat different view:

Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

We also buy Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled from another source, at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10).

On that basis, we have prepared three genuine options. Each offers a longer contract term, giving you planning security, and one combines this with faster payment:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.59; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.43; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.55; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We would be glad to hear which option works best for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
The price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
We welcome the prospect of a 24-month contract to provide mutual planning security.
Please note that for a contract of this duration, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage raw material volatility, and prices from other sources do not reflect our specific material quality.
We can therefore offer €5.70 per unit with a 30-day payment term and the AS-14404 index.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.70 per unit.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your kind reply and for confirming the delivery data. We appreciate that, and we value the long cooperation between our two family companies.

We share your wish for a longer contract that gives both sides planning security, and every option below reflects that. We see your concern about raw material volatility. Instead of an index clause, we have built a fair fixed price into each option, so both sides gain stable, predictable terms. Option C also offers you faster payment.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.60; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.44; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.56; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We look forward to finding a fair solution together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your warm reply and for moving on the base price. We appreciate it, and we value the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies.

We understand your concern about raw material volatility. Rather than an index clause, each option below gives both sides a fixed price and full planning security over the whole contract. Option C answers your wish for faster payment, and Option B offers a balanced middle path.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.60; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.44; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.56; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We believe these are fair terms for both family companies and look forward to your choice.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your response; however, as your proposed terms remain unchanged, we cannot adjust our offer. As a reliable distributor, we always strive to provide you with the best support and top-tier service across our entire product range, and we are truly keen to keep serving you. 

Please understand that for a 24-month contract, the AS-14404 index clause is mandatory to manage raw material volatility. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. We therefore maintain our offer of EUR 5.60 per unit with a 60-day payment term and the AS-14404 index clause. 

To confirm, our Angebot stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
